properties.entry:
Authorization Field ZADTPY_AF1 contains errors and therefore cannot be saved

Message No. SWB_TOOL036

Diagnosis

This is an object which can only be saved in active state.

It must be free of errors before it can be saved.

System Response

Procedure

Call the ‘Check’ function to see which syntax errors exist.

Remove these errors and try to save again.

Procedure for System Administration
